Construct an evaluable family specification

Source: R/family_spec.R
family_spec.Rd

A family_spec exposes, as pure functions, the pieces koine needs to compute a pointwise log-likelihood and a posterior-predictive draw for any lens that does not emit them natively. This low-level constructor is normally reached through as_family_spec(), which adapts a base-R family object.

Usage

family_spec(
  name,
  link,
  linkinv,
  loglik_pointwise,
  rng,
  support_check,
  aux_params = character(0),
  dlp_deta = NULL,
  d2lp_deta2 = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Family name, e.g. "gaussian", "binomial", "poisson".

link

Link name, e.g. "identity", "logit", "log".

linkinv

Function mapping the linear predictor eta to the response-scale mean mu.

loglik_pointwise

Function (y, eta, aux) returning a length-N vector of log p(y_i | eta_i, aux). The contract koine relies on.

rng

Function (eta, aux) returning one posterior-predictive draw y_tilde (used only when posterior-predictive output is requested).

support_check

Function (y) returning TRUE if y lies in the family support.

aux_params

Character vector naming the auxiliary parameters (e.g. "sigma" for Gaussian, none for Binomial).

dlp_deta

Optional function (y, eta, aux) returning the first derivative of the pointwise log-likelihood with respect to the linear predictor (the canonical-link score), used by adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature to locate the random-effect integrand's mode.

d2lp_deta2

Optional function (y, eta, aux) returning the second derivative (the negative observed information), used for the quadrature's curvature scaling.

Value

An object of class koine_family_spec.

See also

as_family_spec()

Examples

# normally reached through as_family_spec(); the low-level constructor:
fs <- family_spec(
  name = "gaussian", link = "identity",
  linkinv = function(eta) eta,
  loglik_pointwise = function(y, eta, aux) {
    stats::dnorm(y, eta, aux$sigma, log = TRUE)
  },
  rng = function(eta, aux) stats::rnorm(length(eta), eta, aux$sigma),
  support_check = function(y) all(is.finite(y)),
  aux_params = "sigma")
fs$loglik_pointwise(c(0, 1), c(0, 1), list(sigma = 1))
#> [1] -0.9189385 -0.9189385
